## 0.2 Loading Data

```{r load-data}
data("GBSG2", package = "TH.data")

GBSG2$y_surv        <- with(GBSG2, Surv(time, cens))
GBSG2$horTh_numeric <- ifelse(GBSG2$horTh == "yes", 1, 0)

# Data frame without Surv column for full compatibility with the pec package
clean_data        <- GBSG2
clean_data$y_surv <- NULL

eval_times <- seq(100, 2500, by = 100)
```

## 0.3 Baseline Cox & Weibull Models

```{r baseline-models}
cox_fit <- coxph(y_surv ~ horTh, data = GBSG2, x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
print(cox_fit)

cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")

weibull_fit <- survreg(y_surv ~ horTh, data = GBSG2, dist = "weibull", x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
print(weibull_fit)
```

```{r glm-tree}
  cens ~ horTh | age + menostat + tsize + tgrade + progrec + estrec + pnodes,
  data   = GBSG2,
  family = binomial
)
```

# 3. Survival GLM Tree (MOB: Weibull & Cox)

```{r survival-glm-tree}
glm_formula_surv <- Surv(time, cens) ~ horTh | age + tsize + tgrade + pnodes + progrec + estrec

# ==============================================================================
# 3.1 GLM Tree + Weibull
# ==============================================================================
weibull_fitter <- function(y, x, start = NULL, weights = NULL, offset = NULL, ...,
                           estfun = FALSE, object = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(weights)) weights <- rep(1, NROW(y))
  if (is.null(offset))  offset  <- rep(0, NROW(y))

  if (ncol(x) == 0L) {
    mod <- survreg(y ~ 1 + offset(offset), weights = weights, dist = "weibull", x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
  } else {
    mod <- survreg(y ~ 0 + x + offset(offset), weights = weights, dist = "weibull", x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
  }

  cf        <- coef(mod)
  names(cf) <- colnames(x)
  ef        <- if (estfun) as.matrix(sandwich::estfun(mod)) else NULL

  list(
    coefficients = cf,
    objfun       = -as.numeric(logLik(mod)),
    estfun       = ef,
    object       = mod
  )
}

mob_weibull <- mob(glm_formula_surv, data = clean_data, fit = weibull_fitter)
plot(mob_weibull, main = "mob_weibull : Survival GLM Tree")
print(mob_weibull, node = 1)

# ==============================================================================
# 3.2 GLM Tree + Cox PH
# ==============================================================================
cox_fitter <- function(y, x, start = NULL, weights = NULL, offset = NULL, ...,
                       estfun = FALSE, object = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(weights)) weights <- rep(1, NROW(y))
  if (is.null(offset))  offset  <- rep(0, NROW(y))

  x    <- x[, colnames(x) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]
  df_x <- as.data.frame(x)

  if (ncol(x) == 0L) {
    mod <- coxph(y ~ 1 + offset(offset), weights = weights, x = TRUE, y = TRUE, model = TRUE)
  } else {
    mod <- coxph(y ~ . + offset(offset), data = df_x, weights = weights, x = TRUE, y = TRUE, model = TRUE)
  }

  cf        <- coef(mod)
  names(cf) <- colnames(x)

  ef <- NULL
  if (estfun) {
    ef           <- as.matrix(sandwich::estfun(mod))
    colnames(ef) <- names(cf)
  }

  list(
    coefficients = cf,
    objfun       = -as.numeric(logLik(mod)),
    estfun       = ef,
    object       = mod
  )
}

mob_cox <- mob(glm_formula_surv, data = clean_data, fit = cox_fitter)
plot(mob_cox, main = "mob_cox : Survival GLM Tree")
print(mob_cox, node = 1)
```

# 4. Survival PALM Tree (`palmtree_AmirR`)

```{r survival-palmtree}
# ==============================================================================
# 4.1 Node Fitter for mob (Weibull / Cox)
# ==============================================================================
make_surv_fit <- function(method = c("weibull", "cox"), test_scale = FALSE) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  force(test_scale)

  function(y, x, start = NULL, weights = NULL, offset = NULL, ...,
           estfun = FALSE, object = FALSE) {
    n <- NROW(x)
    if (is.null(offset))  offset  <- rep(0, n)
    if (is.null(weights)) weights <- rep(1, n)
    x <- x[, colnames(x) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]

    if (method == "weibull") {
      if (ncol(x) == 0L) {
        mod <- survreg(y ~ 1 + offset(offset), weights = weights, dist = "weibull")
      } else {
        mod <- survreg(y ~ x + offset(offset), weights = weights, dist = "weibull")
      }
      cf        <- coef(mod)
      names(cf) <- c("(Intercept)", colnames(x))
    } else {
      if (ncol(x) == 0L) {
        mod <- coxph(y ~ 1 + offset(offset), weights = weights)
      } else {
        mod <- coxph(y ~ x + offset(offset), weights = weights)
      }
      cf        <- coef(mod)
      names(cf) <- colnames(x)
    }

    ef <- NULL
    if (estfun) {
      ef <- tryCatch(
        as.matrix(sandwich::estfun(mod)),
        error = function(e) stop("sandwich::estfun() failed: ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
      )
      if (method == "weibull" && !test_scale && ncol(ef) > length(cf)) {
        ef <- ef[, seq_along(cf), drop = FALSE] # Remove Log(scale) column
      }
    }

    list(
      coefficients = cf,
      objfun       = -as.numeric(logLik(mod)),
      estfun       = ef,
      object       = if (object) mod else NULL
    )
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# 4.2 Helper Functions (Unified Pipeline for lm / glm / weibull / cox)
# ==============================================================================
.palm_fit <- function(form, data, method, family = NULL) {
  switch(
    method,
    lm      = if (is.null(family)) lm(form, data = data, weights = .weights)
              else glm(form, data = data, weights = .weights, family = family),
    weibull = survreg(form, data = data, weights = .weights, dist = "weibull", model = TRUE),
    cox     = coxph(form, data = data, weights = .weights, model = TRUE)
  )
}

.lin_pred <- function(fit, data, method, zero = NULL) {
  if (method == "lm") {
    if (!is.null(zero)) fit$coefficients[zero] <- 0
    return(as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data)))
  }
  cf            <- coef(fit)
  cf[is.na(cf)] <- 0
  if (!is.null(zero)) cf[zero] <- 0

  tt <- delete.response(terms(fit))
  mf <- model.frame(tt, data = data, xlev = fit$xlevels, na.action = na.pass)
  X  <- model.matrix(tt, mf, contrasts.arg = fit$contrasts)
  as.numeric(X[, names(cf), drop = FALSE] %*% cf)
}

# ==============================================================================
# 4.3 Main Function: palmtree_AmirR
# ==============================================================================
palmtree_AmirR <- function(formula, data, weights = NULL,
                           method = c("lm", "weibull", "cox"),
                           family = NULL, lmstart = NULL,
                           abstol = 0.001, maxit = 100, dfsplit = TRUE,
                           verbose = FALSE, plot = FALSE,
                           test_scale = FALSE, ...) {
  cl      <- match.call()
  method  <- match.arg(method)
  fit_fun <- if (method == "lm") NULL else make_surv_fit(method, test_scale)

  if (!is.null(family) && method == "lm") {
    if (!inherits(family, "family")) {
      if (is.character(family)) family <- get(family)
      if (is.function(family))  family <- family()
    }
  }

  ff        <- Formula::as.Formula(formula)
  tf        <- formula(ff, lhs = 1L, rhs = c(1L, 3L))
  rf        <- formula(ff, lhs = 1L, rhs = 1L)
  intercept <- attr(terms(rf), "intercept") > 0L
  if (!intercept) rf <- update(rf, . ~ . + 1)

  # Extract exact column names of global variables from the 2nd RHS part
  gf           <- formula(ff, lhs = 0L, rhs = 2L)
  global_mm    <- model.matrix(terms(gf), data = data)
  global_names <- setdiff(colnames(global_mm), "(Intercept)")

  rf0 <- formula(Formula::as.Formula(rf, gf), lhs = 1L, rhs = c(1L, 2L), collapse = TRUE)
  rf  <- if (intercept) update(rf, . ~ .tree / .) else update(rf, . ~ .tree : .)
  rf  <- formula(Formula::as.Formula(rf, gf), lhs = 1L, rhs = c(1L, 2L), collapse = TRUE)

  data$.weights <- if (is.null(weights)) rep(1, nrow(data)) else weights
  iteration     <- 0L

  # Initial offset (zeroing out local coefficients from step 1)
  if (is.null(lmstart)) {
    fit0      <- .palm_fit(rf0, data, method, family)
    is_local0 <- !(names(coef(fit0)) %in% global_names)
    lmstart   <- .lin_pred(fit0, data, method, zero = is_local0)
  }
  data$.lm <- lmstart

  continue  <- TRUE
  oldloglik <- -Inf

  while (continue) {
    iteration <- iteration + 1L

    # Step A: Fit tree with current offset
    tree <- if (method == "lm") {
      if (is.null(family)) {
        lmtree(tf, data = data, offset = .lm, weights = .weights, dfsplit = FALSE, ...)
      } else {
        glmtree(tf, data = data, offset = .lm, weights = .weights, dfsplit = FALSE,
                family = family, ...)
      }
    } else {
      mob(tf, data = data, weights = .weights, offset = .lm, fit = fit_fun,
          control = mob_control(dfsplit = FALSE, ...))
    }
    if (plot) plot(tree)

    data$.tree <- factor(predict(tree, newdata = data, type = "node"))
    multi      <- nlevels(data$.tree) > 1L

    # Step B: Fit global PALM model
    palm <- .palm_fit(if (multi) rf else rf0, data, method, family)
    nm   <- names(coef(palm))

    # Step C: Identify local coefficients
    is_local <- !(nm %in% global_names)

    # Step D: Compute pure global offset
    data$.lm <- .lin_pred(palm, data, method, zero = is_local)

    newloglik <- as.numeric(logLik(palm))
    continue  <- (newloglik - oldloglik > abstol) & (iteration < maxit)
    oldloglik <- newloglik

    if (verbose) {
      cat(sprintf("Iteration: %d | Log-Likelihood: %.4f\n", iteration, oldloglik))
    }
  }

  result <- list(
    formula     = formula,
    call        = cl,
    method      = method,
    tree        = tree,
    palm        = palm,
    data        = data,
    nobs        = nrow(data),
    loglik      = newloglik,
    df          = attr(logLik(palm), "df"),
    dfsplit     = dfsplit,
    iterations  = iteration,
    maxit       = maxit,
    lmstart     = lmstart,
    abstol      = abstol,
    intercept   = intercept,
    family      = family,
    mob.control = list(...)
  )
  class(result) <- "palmtree"
  result
}

# ==============================================================================
# 4.4 Validation and Execution on GBSG2 Dataset
# ==============================================================================
check_offset <- function(fit, globals = c("age", "tsize")) {
  b      <- coef(fit$palm)[globals]
  manual <- as.numeric(as.matrix(fit$data[, globals]) %*% b)
  max(abs(fit$data$.lm - manual))
}

form_surv <- Surv(time, cens) ~ horTh | age + tsize | pnodes + progrec + estrec
form_lm   <- log(time) ~ horTh | age + tsize | pnodes + progrec + estrec

m_weibull <- palmtree_AmirR(form_surv, data = clean_data, method = "weibull", minsize = 20, verbose = TRUE)
m_cox     <- palmtree_AmirR(form_surv, data = clean_data, method = "cox",     minsize = 20, verbose = TRUE)
m_lm      <- palmtree_AmirR(form_lm,   data = clean_data, method = "lm",      minsize = 20, verbose = TRUE)

print(summary(m_weibull$palm))
plot(m_weibull$tree, main = "Weibull PALM Tree")

print(summary(m_cox$palm))
plot(m_cox$tree, main = "Cox PALM Tree")

print(summary(m_lm$palm))
plot(m_lm$tree, main = "LM PALM Tree")

sapply(list(weibull = m_weibull, cox = m_cox, lm = m_lm), check_offset)
```

# 6. Model Evaluation (C-Index & Brier Score)

## 6.1 Cox Models: C-Index & Brier Score

```{r eval-cox}
# ==============================================================================
# Survival Probability Prediction Methods (predictSurvProb) for Cox Trees
# ==============================================================================
predictSurvProb.modelparty <- function(object, newdata, times, ...) {
  nodes        <- predict(object, newdata = newdata, type = "node")
  unique_nodes <- unique(nodes)
  prob_matrix  <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(newdata), ncol = length(times))

  tt_reg <- delete.response(object$info$terms$response)
  mf_all <- model.frame(tt_reg, data = newdata, na.action = na.pass)
  X_all  <- model.matrix(tt_reg, mf_all)
  X_all  <- X_all[, colnames(X_all) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]
  df_all <- as.data.frame(X_all)

  for (nd in unique_nodes) {
    node_model <- object[[nd]]$node$info$object
    idx        <- which(nodes == nd)
    df_node    <- df_all[idx, , drop = FALSE]

    sf         <- survival::survfit(node_model, newdata = df_node)
    sf_summary <- summary(sf, times = times, extend = TRUE)

    if (length(idx) == 1L) {
      prob_matrix[idx, ] <- sf_summary$surv
    } else {
      prob_matrix[idx, ] <- t(sf_summary$surv)
    }
  }
  prob_matrix
}

predictSurvProb.palmtree <- function(object, newdata, times, ...) {
  nodes         <- predict(object$tree, newdata = newdata, type = "node")
  newdata$.tree <- factor(nodes, levels = levels(object$data$.tree))

  palm_model <- object$palm
  train_data <- object$data

  tt       <- terms(palm_model)
  mf_train <- model.frame(tt, data = train_data, xlev = palm_model$xlevels)
  X_train  <- model.matrix(tt, mf_train)
  X_train  <- X_train[, colnames(X_train) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]
  Y_train  <- model.response(mf_train)

  valid_names   <- make.names(colnames(X_train))
  df_train_flat <- cbind(
    data.frame(Y_surv = Y_train),
    setNames(as.data.frame(X_train), valid_names)
  )

  surrogate_form <- as.formula(paste("Y_surv ~", paste(valid_names, collapse = " + ")))
  surrogate_cox  <- coxph(surrogate_form, data = df_train_flat)

  tt_new      <- delete.response(tt)
  mf_new      <- model.frame(tt_new, data = newdata, xlev = palm_model$xlevels, na.action = na.pass)
  X_new       <- model.matrix(tt_new, mf_new)
  X_new       <- X_new[, colnames(X_new) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]
  df_new_flat <- setNames(as.data.frame(X_new), valid_names)

  sf         <- survival::survfit(surrogate_cox, newdata = df_new_flat)
  sf_summary <- summary(sf, times = times, extend = TRUE)

  if (nrow(newdata) == 1L) {
    matrix(sf_summary$surv, nrow = 1L)
  } else {
    t(sf_summary$surv)
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Harrell's C-Index (Cox Models)
# ==============================================================================
med_time       <- median(clean_data$time)
surv_mob_cox   <- predictSurvProb(mob_cox, newdata = clean_data, times = med_time)[, 1]
cindex_mob_cox <- concordance(GBSG2$y_surv ~ surv_mob_cox)$concordance

cat("Harrell's C-index (Standard Cox):", summary(cox_fit)$concordance[1], "\n")
cat("Harrell's C-index (MOB Cox):     ", cindex_mob_cox, "\n")
cat("Harrell's C-index (PALM Cox):    ", summary(m_cox$palm)$concordance[1], "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Brier Score (Individual & Combined Cox Models)
# ==============================================================================
cox_fit_clean <- coxph(Surv(time, cens) ~ horTh, data = clean_data, x = TRUE, y = TRUE)

brier_std_cox <- pec(
  object  = list(Cox = cox_fit_clean),
  data    = clean_data,
  formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ 1,
  times   = eval_times,
  exact   = FALSE
)
print(brier_std_cox)
plot(brier_std_cox, main = "Brier Score over Time: Standard Cox Model")

brier_mob_cox <- pec(
  object  = list(Mob_Cox_Tree = mob_cox),
  data    = clean_data,
  formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ 1,
  times   = eval_times,
  exact   = FALSE
)
print(brier_mob_cox)
plot(brier_mob_cox, main = "Brier Score over Time: MOB Cox Tree", col = c("black", "blue"), legend = TRUE)

brier_m_cox <- pec(
  object  = list(PALM_Cox = m_cox),
  data    = clean_data,
  formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ 1,
  times   = eval_times,
  exact   = FALSE
)
print(brier_m_cox)
plot(brier_m_cox, main = "Brier Score over Time: PALM Cox Tree", col = c("black", "darkgreen"), legend = TRUE)

brier_all_cox <- pec(
  object = list(
    Standard_Cox  = cox_fit_clean,
    GLM_Tree_Cox  = mob_cox,
    PALM_Tree_Cox = m_cox
  ),
  data    = clean_data,
  formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ 1,
  times   = eval_times,
  exact   = FALSE
)
print(brier_all_cox)
plot(
  brier_all_cox,
  main   = "Cox Models Comparison: Prediction Error (Brier Score)",
  col    = c("black", "blue", "red", "darkgreen"),
  lty    = c(1, 1, 2, 2),
  legend = TRUE
)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Time-Dependent C-Index (All Cox Models)
# ==============================================================================
cindex_all_cox <- cindex(
  object = list(
    Standard_Cox  = cox_fit_clean,
    GLM_Tree_Cox  = mob_cox,
    PALM_Tree_Cox = m_cox
  ),
  formula    = Surv(time, cens) ~ 1,
  data       = clean_data,
  eval.times = eval_times
)
print(cindex_all_cox)
plot(
  cindex_all_cox,
  main   = "Time-Dependent C-Index: Cox Models Comparison",
  col    = c("blue", "red", "darkgreen"),
  lty    = c(1, 2, 2),
  legend = TRUE,
  ylim   = c(0.4, 1)
)
```

## 6.2 Weibull Models: C-Index & Brier Score

```{r eval-weibull}
# ==============================================================================
# Survival Probability Prediction Methods (predictSurvProb) for Weibull Models
# ==============================================================================
predictSurvProb.survreg <- function(object, newdata, times, ...) {
  lp    <- predict(object, newdata = newdata, type = "lp")
  scale <- object$scale

  prob_matrix <- sapply(times, function(t) {
    if (t <= 0) rep(1, length(lp)) else exp(-exp((log(t) - lp) / scale))
  })

  if (length(lp) == 1L) matrix(prob_matrix, nrow = 1L) else prob_matrix
}

class(mob_weibull) <- c("mob_weib_tree", class(mob_weibull))

predictSurvProb.mob_weib_tree <- function(object, newdata, times, ...) {
  nodes        <- predict(object, newdata = newdata, type = "node")
  unique_nodes <- unique(nodes)
  prob_matrix  <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(newdata), ncol = length(times))

  tt_reg <- delete.response(object$info$terms$response)
  mf_all <- model.frame(tt_reg, data = newdata, na.action = na.pass)
  X_all  <- model.matrix(tt_reg, mf_all)

  for (nd in unique_nodes) {
    node_model <- object[[nd]]$node$info$object
    idx        <- which(nodes == nd)
    X_node     <- X_all[idx, , drop = FALSE]

    lp    <- as.numeric(X_node %*% coef(node_model))
    scale <- node_model$scale

    node_probs <- sapply(times, function(t) {
      if (t <= 0) rep(1, length(lp)) else exp(-exp((log(t) - lp) / scale))
    })

    prob_matrix[idx, ] <- if (length(idx) == 1L) matrix(node_probs, nrow = 1L) else node_probs
  }
  prob_matrix
}

class(m_weibull) <- c("palm_weibull", class(m_weibull))

predictSurvProb.palm_weibull <- function(object, newdata, times, ...) {
  nodes         <- predict(object$tree, newdata = newdata, type = "node")
  newdata$.tree <- factor(nodes, levels = levels(object$data$.tree))

  palm_model <- object$palm
  train_data <- object$data

  tt       <- terms(palm_model)
  mf_train <- model.frame(tt, data = train_data, xlev = palm_model$xlevels)
  X_train  <- model.matrix(tt, mf_train)
  X_train  <- X_train[, colnames(X_train) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]
  Y_train  <- model.response(mf_train)

  valid_names          <- make.names(colnames(X_train))
  df_train_flat        <- setNames(as.data.frame(X_train), valid_names)
  df_train_flat$Y_surv <- Y_train

  surrogate_form    <- as.formula(paste("Y_surv ~", paste(valid_names, collapse = " + ")))
  surrogate_weibull <- survreg(surrogate_form, data = df_train_flat, dist = "weibull")

  tt_new      <- delete.response(tt)
  mf_new      <- model.frame(tt_new, data = newdata, xlev = palm_model$xlevels, na.action = na.pass)
  X_new       <- model.matrix(tt_new, mf_new)
  X_new       <- X_new[, colnames(X_new) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]
  df_new_flat <- setNames(as.data.frame(X_new), valid_names)

  lp    <- predict(surrogate_weibull, newdata = df_new_flat, type = "lp")
  scale <- surrogate_weibull$scale

  prob_matrix <- sapply(times, function(t) {
    if (t <= 0) rep(1, length(lp)) else exp(-exp((log(t) - lp) / scale))
  })

  if (length(lp) == 1L) matrix(prob_matrix, nrow = 1L) else prob_matrix
}

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Harrell's C-Index (Weibull Models)
# ==============================================================================
surv_mob_weibull <- predictSurvProb(mob_weibull, newdata = clean_data, times = med_time)[, 1]
c_index_mob_w    <- concordance(GBSG2$y_surv ~ surv_mob_weibull)$concordance

cat("Harrell's C-index (Standard Weibull):", concordance(weibull_fit)$concordance, "\n")
cat("Harrell's C-index (MOB Weibull):     ", c_index_mob_w, "\n")
cat("Harrell's C-index (PALM Weibull):    ", concordance(m_weibull$palm)$concordance, "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Brier Score (Individual & Combined Weibull Models)
# ==============================================================================
std_weibull_fit <- survreg(
  Surv(time, cens) ~ horTh,
  data = clean_data,
  dist = "weibull",
  x    = TRUE,
  y    = TRUE
)

brier_std_weibull <- pec(
  object  = list(Standard_Weibull = std_weibull_fit),
  data    = clean_data,
  formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ 1,
  times   = eval_times,
  exact   = FALSE
)
print(brier_std_weibull)
plot(brier_std_weibull, main = "Brier Score over Time: Standard Weibull", col = c("black", "purple"), legend = TRUE)

brier_mob_weibull <- pec(
  object  = list(Mob_Weibull_Tree = mob_weibull),
  data    = clean_data,
  formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ 1,
  times   = eval_times,
  exact   = FALSE
)
print(brier_mob_weibull)
plot(brier_mob_weibull, main = "Brier Score over Time: MOB Weibull Tree", col = c("black", "orange"), legend = TRUE)

brier_m_weibull <- pec(
  object  = list(PALM_Weibull_Tree = m_weibull),
  data    = clean_data,
  formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ 1,
  times   = eval_times,
  exact   = FALSE
)
print(brier_m_weibull)
plot(brier_m_weibull, main = "Brier Score over Time: PALM Weibull Tree", col = c("black", "brown"), legend = TRUE)

brier_all_weibull <- pec(
  object = list(
    Standard_Weibull  = std_weibull_fit,
    Mob_Weibull_Tree  = mob_weibull,
    PALM_Weibull_Tree = m_weibull
  ),
  data    = clean_data,
  formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ 1,
  times   = eval_times,
  exact   = FALSE
)
print(brier_all_weibull)
plot(
  brier_all_weibull,
  main   = "Weibull Models Comparison: Prediction Error (Brier Score)",
  col    = c("black", "purple", "orange", "brown"),
  lty    = c(1, 1, 2, 2),
  legend = TRUE
)
```

# 7. Simulation Study

## 7.1 Weibull Simulation

```{r sim-weibull}
# ==============================================================================
# Comprehensive Simulation of Survival PALM Trees (PALM-Surv)
# Approach: Parametric Weibull (AFT) Model
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Part 1: Data Generating Processes (DGP) based on Weibull AFT
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Base DGP (for Scenarios 1 and 3)
gen_data_weibull_base <- function(n = 500, cens_rate = 0.05, sigma = 0.7) {
  d <- data.frame(
    trt = factor(rbinom(n, 1, 0.5), levels = 0:1, labels = c("no", "yes")),
    x1  = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
    x2  = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
    z1  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z2  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z3  = runif(n, -1, 1)
  )
  d$true_leaf <- as.integer(d$z1 > 0)

  # AFT linear predictor
  mu <- 2.0 + (0.5 * d$x1) + (-0.3 * d$x2) +
    (d$true_leaf * 1.0) +
    (d$trt == "yes") * (d$true_leaf * 0.8)

  t_event <- exp(mu + sigma * log(rexp(n)))
  t_cens  <- rexp(n, rate = cens_rate)

  d$time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)
  d$cens   <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens)
  d$y_surv <- Surv(d$time, d$cens)
  return(d)
}

# Scenario 2 DGP (No subgroups - Type I Error evaluation)
gen_data_weibull_scen2 <- function(n = 500, cens_rate = 0.05, sigma = 0.7) {
  d <- data.frame(
    trt = factor(rbinom(n, 1, 0.5), levels = 0:1, labels = c("no", "yes")),
    x1  = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
    x2  = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
    z1  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z2  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z3  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z4  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z5  = runif(n, -1, 1)
  )

  # Homogeneous population (no effect of Z)
  mu <- 2.0 + (0.5 * d$x1) + (-0.3 * d$x2) + (d$trt == "yes") * 0.8

  t_event <- exp(mu + sigma * log(rexp(n)))
  t_cens  <- rexp(n, rate = cens_rate)

  d$time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)
  d$cens   <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens)
  d$y_surv <- Surv(d$time, d$cens)
  return(d)
}

# Scenario 4 DGP (Multicollinearity between X1 and Z2)
gen_data_weibull_scen4 <- function(n = 500, cens_rate = 0.05, sigma = 0.7) {
  rho           <- 0.7
  x1            <- rnorm(n, 0, 1)
  z2_correlated <- rho * x1 + sqrt(1 - rho^2) * rnorm(n, 0, 1)

  d <- data.frame(
    trt = factor(rbinom(n, 1, 0.5), levels = 0:1, labels = c("no", "yes")),
    x1  = x1,
    x2  = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
    z1  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z2  = z2_correlated,
    z3  = runif(n, -1, 1)
  )
  d$true_leaf <- as.integer(d$z1 > 0)

  mu <- 2.0 + (0.5 * d$x1) + (-0.3 * d$x2) +
    (d$true_leaf * 1.0) +
    (d$trt == "yes") * (d$true_leaf * 0.8)

  t_event <- exp(mu + sigma * log(rexp(n)))
  t_cens  <- rexp(n, rate = cens_rate)

  d$time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)
  d$cens   <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens)
  d$y_surv <- Surv(d$time, d$cens)
  return(d)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Part 2: Parallel Monte Carlo Simulation Engine
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_weibull_scenario <- function(scenario, R = 100, n = 500, num_cores = 8) {
  true_gamma <- c(x1 = 0.5, x2 = -0.3)

  results <- mclapply(1:R, function(i) {
    # Generate data based on scenario
    if (scenario == 1) {
      data_sim <- gen_data_weibull_base(n = n, cens_rate = 0.05)
      form     <- y_surv ~ trt | x1 + x2 | z1 + z2 + z3
    } else if (scenario == 2) {
      data_sim <- gen_data_weibull_scen2(n = n, cens_rate = 0.05)
      form     <- y_surv ~ trt | x1 + x2 | z1 + z2 + z3 + z4 + z5
    } else if (scenario == 3) {
      data_sim <- gen_data_weibull_base(n = n, cens_rate = 0.8) # High censoring (~90%)
      form     <- y_surv ~ trt | x1 + x2 | z1 + z2 + z3
    } else if (scenario == 4) {
      data_sim <- gen_data_weibull_scen4(n = n, cens_rate = 0.05)
      form     <- y_surv ~ trt | x1 + x2 | z1 + z2 + z3
    }

    obs_cens <- 1 - mean(data_sim$cens)

    # Fit Weibull PALM tree
    fit <- tryCatch({
      palmtree_AmirR(
        formula = form,
        data    = data_sim,
        method  = "weibull",
        minsize = 30
      )
    }, error = function(e) return(NULL))

    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

    predicted_nodes <- fit$data$.tree
    n_leaves        <- nlevels(predicted_nodes)

    if (scenario == 2) {
      metric_val <- as.integer(n_leaves > 1) # False Positive Rate
    } else {
      metric_val <- sum(apply(table(predicted_nodes, data_sim$true_leaf), 1, max)) / nrow(data_sim) # Purity
    }

    est_gamma <- coef(fit$palm)[c("x1", "x2")]

    return(c(n_leaves = n_leaves, metric = metric_val, obs_cens = obs_cens, est_gamma))
  }, mc.cores = num_cores)

  # Filter out failed iterations
  results    <- Filter(Negate(is.null), results)
  res_matrix <- do.call(rbind, results)

  # Compute final summary statistics
  summary_stats <- data.frame(
    Censoring_Rate = mean(res_matrix[, "obs_cens"]),
    Mean_Leaves    = mean(res_matrix[, "n_leaves"])
  )

  if (scenario == 2) {
    summary_stats$Type_I_Error <- mean(res_matrix[, "metric"])
  } else {
    summary_stats$Mean_Purity  <- mean(res_matrix[, "metric"])
  }

  # Use na.rm = TRUE to handle potential variance estimation issues under high censoring
  summary_stats$Bias_x1      <- mean(res_matrix[, "x1"], na.rm = TRUE) - true_gamma["x1"]
  summary_stats$Bias_x2      <- mean(res_matrix[, "x2"], na.rm = TRUE) - true_gamma["x2"]
  summary_stats$RMSE_x1      <- sqrt(mean((res_matrix[, "x1"] - true_gamma["x1"])^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  summary_stats$RMSE_x2      <- sqrt(mean((res_matrix[, "x2"] - true_gamma["x2"])^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  summary_stats$Success_Rate <- nrow(res_matrix) / R

  return(summary_stats)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Part 3: Execute All 4 Scenarios
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG")
cores_to_use <- 8
R_iter       <- 5 # Set to 50 for initial testing

# Scenario 1 (Ideal)
set.seed(2001)
cat("\nRunning Scenario 1 (Weibull - Ideal Structure)...\n")
system.time({ sum_scen1_w <- run_weibull_scenario(1, R = R_iter, num_cores = cores_to_use) })
print("--- Scenario 1 Results ---")
print(sum_scen1_w)

# Scenario 2 (No Subgroup)
set.seed(2002)
cat("\nRunning Scenario 2 (Weibull - Type I Error)...\n")
system.time({ sum_scen2_w <- run_weibull_scenario(2, R = R_iter, num_cores = cores_to_use) })
print("--- Scenario 2 Results ---")
print(sum_scen2_w)

# Scenario 3 (High Censoring)
set.seed(2003)
cat("\nRunning Scenario 3 (Weibull - High Censoring)...\n")
system.time({ sum_scen3_w <- run_weibull_scenario(3, R = R_iter, num_cores = cores_to_use) })
print("--- Scenario 3 Results ---")
print(sum_scen3_w)

# Scenario 4 (Multicollinearity)
set.seed(2004)
cat("\nRunning Scenario 4 (Weibull - Multicollinearity)...\n")
system.time({ sum_scen4_w <- run_weibull_scenario(4, R = R_iter, num_cores = cores_to_use) })
print("--- Scenario 4 Results ---")
print(sum_scen4_w)
```

## 7.2 Cox Simulation

```{r sim-cox}
# ==============================================================================
# Comprehensive Simulation of Survival PALM Trees (PALM-Surv)
# Approach: Semi-parametric Cox Proportional Hazards Model
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Part 1: Data Generating Processes (DGP) under Proportional Hazards (PH)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Base DGP (for Scenarios 1 and 3)
gen_data_cox_base <- function(n = 500, cens_rate = 0.05) {
  d <- data.frame(
    trt = factor(rbinom(n, 1, 0.5), levels = 0:1, labels = c("no", "yes")),
    x1  = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
    x2  = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
    z1  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z2  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z3  = runif(n, -1, 1)
  )
  d$true_leaf <- as.integer(d$z1 > 0)

  # True Cox coefficients (Log Hazard Ratios)
  mu <- (0.5 * d$x1) + (-0.3 * d$x2) +
    (d$true_leaf * 1.0) +
    (d$trt == "yes") * (d$true_leaf * 0.8)

  # Generate survival time under PH assumption (Exponential baseline hazard)
  t_event <- rexp(n) / exp(mu)
  t_cens  <- rexp(n, rate = cens_rate)

  d$time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)
  d$cens   <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens)
  d$y_surv <- Surv(d$time, d$cens)
  return(d)
}

# Scenario 2 DGP (No subgroups)
gen_data_cox_scen2 <- function(n = 500, cens_rate = 0.05) {
  d <- data.frame(
    trt = factor(rbinom(n, 1, 0.5), levels = 0:1, labels = c("no", "yes")),
    x1  = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
    x2  = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
    z1  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z2  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z3  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z4  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z5  = runif(n, -1, 1)
  )

  # Homogeneous population (no effect of z1)
  mu <- (0.5 * d$x1) + (-0.3 * d$x2) + (d$trt == "yes") * 0.8

  t_event <- rexp(n) / exp(mu)
  t_cens  <- rexp(n, rate = cens_rate)

  d$time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)
  d$cens   <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens)
  d$y_surv <- Surv(d$time, d$cens)
  return(d)
}

# Scenario 4 DGP (Multicollinearity)
gen_data_cox_scen4 <- function(n = 500, cens_rate = 0.05) {
  rho           <- 0.7
  x1            <- rnorm(n, 0, 1)
  z2_correlated <- rho * x1 + sqrt(1 - rho^2) * rnorm(n, 0, 1)

  d <- data.frame(
    trt = factor(rbinom(n, 1, 0.5), levels = 0:1, labels = c("no", "yes")),
    x1  = x1,
    x2  = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
    z1  = runif(n, -1, 1),
    z2  = z2_correlated,
    z3  = runif(n, -1, 1)
  )
  d$true_leaf <- as.integer(d$z1 > 0)

  mu <- (0.5 * d$x1) + (-0.3 * d$x2) +
    (d$true_leaf * 1.0) +
    (d$trt == "yes") * (d$true_leaf * 0.8)

  t_event <- rexp(n) / exp(mu)
  t_cens  <- rexp(n, rate = cens_rate)

  d$time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)
  d$cens   <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens)
  d$y_surv <- Surv(d$time, d$cens)
  return(d)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Part 2: Parallel Monte Carlo Simulation Engine
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_cox_scenario <- function(scenario, R = 500, n = 500, num_cores = 8) {
  true_gamma <- c(x1 = 0.5, x2 = -0.3)

  results <- mclapply(1:R, function(i) {
    # Generate data based on scenario
    if (scenario == 1) {
      data_sim <- gen_data_cox_base(n = n, cens_rate = 0.05)
      form     <- y_surv ~ trt | x1 + x2 | z1 + z2 + z3
    } else if (scenario == 2) {
      data_sim <- gen_data_cox_scen2(n = n, cens_rate = 0.05)
      form     <- y_surv ~ trt | x1 + x2 | z1 + z2 + z3 + z4 + z5
    } else if (scenario == 3) {
      data_sim <- gen_data_cox_base(n = n, cens_rate = 1.5) # High censoring rate
      form     <- y_surv ~ trt | x1 + x2 | z1 + z2 + z3
    } else if (scenario == 4) {
      data_sim <- gen_data_cox_scen4(n = n, cens_rate = 0.05)
      form     <- y_surv ~ trt | x1 + x2 | z1 + z2 + z3
    }

    obs_cens <- 1 - mean(data_sim$cens)

    # Fit Cox PALM tree
    fit <- tryCatch({
      palmtree_AmirR(
        formula = form,
        data    = data_sim,
        method  = "cox",
        minsize = 30
      )
    }, error = function(e) return(NULL))

    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

    predicted_nodes <- fit$data$.tree
    n_leaves        <- nlevels(predicted_nodes)

    # Extract scenario-specific metrics
    if (scenario == 2) {
      metric_val <- as.integer(n_leaves > 1) # FPR
    } else {
      metric_val <- sum(apply(table(predicted_nodes, data_sim$true_leaf), 1, max)) / nrow(data_sim) # Purity
    }

    est_gamma <- coef(fit$palm)[c("x1", "x2")]

    return(c(n_leaves = n_leaves, metric = metric_val, obs_cens = obs_cens, est_gamma))
  }, mc.cores = num_cores)

  # Filter out failed iterations
  results    <- Filter(Negate(is.null), results)
  res_matrix <- do.call(rbind, results)

  # Compile final summary statistics
  summary_stats <- data.frame(
    Censoring_Rate = mean(res_matrix[, "obs_cens"]),
    Mean_Leaves    = mean(res_matrix[, "n_leaves"])
  )

  if (scenario == 2) {
    summary_stats$Type_I_Error <- mean(res_matrix[, "metric"])
  } else {
    summary_stats$Mean_Purity  <- mean(res_matrix[, "metric"])
  }

  summary_stats$Bias_x1      <- mean(res_matrix[, "x1"], na.rm = TRUE) - true_gamma["x1"]
  summary_stats$Bias_x2      <- mean(res_matrix[, "x2"], na.rm = TRUE) - true_gamma["x2"]
  summary_stats$RMSE_x1      <- sqrt(mean((res_matrix[, "x1"] - true_gamma["x1"])^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  summary_stats$RMSE_x2      <- sqrt(mean((res_matrix[, "x2"] - true_gamma["x2"])^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  summary_stats$Success_Rate <- nrow(res_matrix) / R

  return(summary_stats)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Part 3: Execute All 4 Scenarios
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG")
cores_to_use <- 8
R_iter       <- 50

# Scenario 1 (Ideal)
set.seed(3001)
cat("\nRunning Scenario 1 (Cox - Ideal Structure)...\n")
system.time({ sum_scen1 <- run_cox_scenario(1, R = R_iter, num_cores = cores_to_use) })
print("--- Scenario 1 Results ---")
print(sum_scen1)

# Scenario 2 (No Subgroup)
set.seed(3002)
cat("\nRunning Scenario 2 (Cox - Type I Error)...\n")
system.time({ sum_scen2 <- run_cox_scenario(2, R = R_iter, num_cores = cores_to_use) })
print("--- Scenario 2 Results ---")
print(sum_scen2)

# Scenario 3 (High Censoring)
set.seed(3003)
cat("\nRunning Scenario 3 (Cox - High Censoring)...\n")
system.time({ sum_scen3 <- run_cox_scenario(3, R = R_iter, num_cores = cores_to_use) })
print("--- Scenario 3 Results ---")
print(sum_scen3)

# Scenario 4 (Multicollinearity)
set.seed(3004)
cat("\nRunning Scenario 4 (Cox - Multicollinearity)...\n")
system.time({ sum_scen4 <- run_cox_scenario(4, R = R_iter, num_cores = cores_to_use) })
print("--- Scenario 4 Results ---")
print(sum_scen4)
```

```{r sim-viz}
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "top",
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p2)
```
